messages:
Marta (CS): quick heads up on Orchid onboarding — account health trending mixed. p50 looks fine but p95 spikes and token costs are climbing; they're at risk before renewal. thinking proactive optimization: int4 quant for their model, swap convo traffic to the 3B variant, and route long-context requests to a dedicated pool on business hours. want to coordinate a canary and an enablement doc.

Jun Park: can you paste the latency slices and a sample prompt size distribution? helps me size batch/kv cache and estimate quality delta.

Marta (CS): sure — pasted quick metrics below. this was last 24h:
```
p50: 120ms
p95: 780ms
p99: 1.2s
avg tokens/request: 420
% requests > 1024 tokens: 18%
cost/mo growth (30d): +320%
```

Jun Park: ok. two obvious tradeoffs: int4 likely saves ~30-40% cost but can add hallucination/regression risk depending on toks per sequence and recent ops. model swap to 3B for short convo paths should cut latency a lot. propose: 10% canary -> run eval set + sampling-based quality checks -> fallback to hosted baseline model on quality regression.

Sanjay Iyer: this ties directly to renewal — if we show a measurable cost reduction with negligible UX regression we can reduce churn risk. I'll own the customer comms and present the playbook in the renewal call. can we get numbers to present? a conservative ROI estimate helps. :thumbsup:

Alex Li: I'll assemble an eval harness and a short prompt set that mirrors their top intents. Jun, can you add a routing policy snippet I can use in docs? simple JSON or YAML is fine.

Jun Park: sample routing snippet (will iterate in infra repo):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: { max_tokens: 1024 }
    route: dedicated-3b-pool
    weight: 0.75
  - match: { min_tokens: 1025 }
    route: dedicated-int4-pool
    weight: 0.9
  - fallback: hosted-baseline
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1767777799 — Orchid: 10% traffic -> dedicated-int4-model-v2. Canary id: canary-orchid-042.

Marta (CS): perfect. action items:
- Jun: implement int4 build + routing canary (due Tue EOD)
- Alex: eval harness + baseline comparison (due Wed noon)
- Sanjay: schedule renewal sync and prepare ROI slides (due Thu)

Also note: include a short rollback window and an automatic fallback to hosted baseline if customer-facing eval drops > 1% accuracy on the intent set. tagging @Jun Park @Alex Li @Sanjay Iyer — can we sync Thurs 10am PT?

Jun Park: I can make Thu 10am PT. will post canary logs in this thread as we get them.

Alex Li: I'll upload eval CI results here when ready.

Sanjay Iyer: thanks — I'll flag this in the renewal doc and keep execs updated.

Marta (CS): thanks team :rocket: — this should buy us runway and strengthen the renewal ask.
